subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should @agent autocomplete extend the existing slash/composer suggestion model using agents.list, introduce a dedicated agents.directory plus rich-chip editor/API, or wait for broader composer-suggestion design with custom terms?
rationale: The request adds user-facing composer behavior and possible Gateway protocol surface; automation cannot safely choose between reusing the existing agent metadata path, adding a new RPC, or adopting a richer editor model.

options.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
options.body: Use the current slash-menu/composer path as the starting point and add API surface only for a proven agent metadata gap.

options.title: Approve Dedicated Mentions API
options.body: Treat agents.directory and rich mention chips as a new Control UI/API direction with accessibility, IME, paste, serialization, and history proof required.

options.title: Defer To Broader UX Planning
options.body: Keep chat composer suggestions slash-only until maintainers scope @agent and custom-term autocomplete together.

recommendation.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
recommendation.body: Use the current slash-menu/composer path as the starting point and add API surface only for a proven agent metadata gap.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest combined signal from the chat composer/slash UX PR history and adjacent composer-suggestion triage.
